title.narrative: Provision of winterization support to the affected populations residing in Ukraine

description.narrative: ltpgtWith this proposal, PAH is prioritizing people living in substandard housing with critical interventions that can ensure secure, warm, safe and dignified living conditions. With this approach, PAH aims at providing critical, timely life-saving interventions to protect the most vulnerable including IDPs, the elderly, people with disabilities, single heads of HH and or women who are the main caregivers in the family. ltbrgtAccording to the Ukraine 2024 Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan, over 3.3 million people are in need of assistance in the front-line communities in the east and the south of the country. According to the July 2024 Ukraine Situation Report waves of strikes on energy infrastructure impacted access to essential services for millions of people, and the situation is expected to worsen in winter combined with possible electricity cutoffs. ltbrgtIn line with the Priority 1 (Winter energy needs) PAH winterization support will cover Chernihivska and Kharkivska oblasts, prioritizing settlements and hromadas close to the contact line or affected by the conflict. The intervention will target 1150 households (2300 indiv.) in the East (Kharkivska oblast 350 — in-kind / 800 — cash) and 200 households (340 indiv.) in the North (Chernihivska oblast). ltbrgtDuring implementation and in preparation for implementation, PAH will build on the ongoing operational presence in the locations already mentioned - Chernihivska Oblast has previously been supported by PAH Shelter-NFI programs aimed at energy, winterization and construction materials, while Kharkivska Oblast has a permanent operational presence of the PAH team in the form of various protection programs in stationary community centers for vulnerable populations. ltbrgtPAH's team will focus on supporting the population in the form of cash support to prepare for the winter period, while the implementing partner (IP), Charitable Foundation for Kindness and Love (CFKL), will fully implement in-kind support for the population, focusing on Kharkivska oblast to target the most vulnerable population groups. PAH will use Ukrpostha as its financial service provider and distributor to ensure inclusion of immobile people in the project. ltbrgtIn line with the Priority 2, PAH will prioritize small repairs and insulation work to improve the thermal envelope in the Collective Sites. PAH will support four collective sites with an overall population of 400 in Kharkivska oblast, while maintaining flexibility to shift activities to Dnipropetrovska oblast to ensure better coordination with other CCCM actors. The repair works at the CSs will include construction works related to the process of preparing for the winter period and improving the energy (+thermal) efficiency of buildings and structures. ltbrgtThe appropriate coordination and cooperation with relevant clusters and representatives of local authorities will be carried out at all stages of the project. ltbrgtTo further strengthen comprehensive cross-cutting approach throughout the proposed project, PAH will implement the following: ltbrgtlt/pgtltulgtltligtwill produce leaflets and posters on GBV prevention with the contact information where to refer in case of GBV as well as leaflets with the contact of LGBTQI+-focused NGOs along with protection awareness-raising sessions lt/ligtltligtInclusion and access of people with disabilities will be ensured through cash provider selection, modality of distribution of winterization NFI as well as the type of it along with accessibility improvement in targeted CSs. lt/ligtltligtLocalization: partnership with local CFKL and building their capacity and ensuring duty of care. lt/ligtltligtProtection mainstreaming and PSEA trainings along with regular psychological supervisions conducted by PAH protection team. lt/ligtltligtFurthermore, to build the synergy between the given project and other PAH activities PAH mobile groups consisting of psychologists and lawyer already operating in the areas of operation will cover psychological and legal requests of beneficiaries if any. lt/ligtlt/ulgtltpgtltbrgtlt/pgt
